mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in unemployment rate over the past 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering immediate equity sell-offs due to reduced consumer spending and corporate hiring freezes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises by >0.3pp over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction, forecasting negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as economic slowdowns reduce corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 115 indicates robust supply growth without bottlenecks, enabling corporate margin expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as inflationary pressures remain contained.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO exceeds 115, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in residential construction (HOUST) over 3 months signals strong housing demand, driving near-term equity gains as the sector fuels economic expansion and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST has increased for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as higher borrowing costs suppress economic activity and corporate investment.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market contraction, forecasting negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as hiring freezes reduce near-term earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 110 indicates supply constraints intensifying, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as inflationary pressures reduce corporate margins and consumer purchasing power.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO falls below 110, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
